_about: Story state, reader-safe. Claude-owned. Update after every scene and climax. Never put real-world numbers here; GM-only state (plan, flags, factions, companions to come) lives in saga/state/_gm/plan.json and approval moves only through saga.py add. covers lists the days a scene drew on; whether a day is closed lives in the Ledger, not here. The site's Now page gives each field one job, so a fact belongs in one of them: last_beat is the latest scene or Between, current_quest.on_the_page the quest, current_struggle what he is fighting (a sentence or two), location.detail where he is (a phrase); a companion's line there is their character file's last_seen_doing.

location.detail: inside the wicket by the gate lamp at dusk, with Hollis in his chair, Wren, the almoner and Rae in the kitchen door
location._about: place is an id from saga/state/places.json; detail is a short phrase, where in the place he is (the site prints it after the place's name). Weather is season's, events are last_beat's

season: first snow of the year on the Steps

current_quest.name: The List
current_quest.on_the_page: The Confessors have come for the Faithless at Saint Ysolde's with a list: Darrow first, Hollis second. What stands between them and the hall is Old Mercy, the sanctuary bell: while it rings at dawn and dusk, no blade passes the gate and no name under it is taken down against its will. Marrant has not drawn a blade in a month. He has camped on the lower terrace, kept the cage, and reached into the House by the lever: a clerk in grey who never kneels sent two black slivers up in the House's own letter-satchel, one of them now set in the rock under the row and making the stone grow frost, and holds the almoner's sister at Calden for the second. Banners that are not grey are on the Holloway, a day off.
current_quest._about: on_the_page is what the site shows and must be supported by the chronicle; the GM's own summary lives in saga/state/_gm/plan.json (quest_summary). One job: the quest itself (who wants what, what stands in the way, the price), not the latest scene (last_beat) or what he is fighting (current_struggle)

current_struggle: What a captain does with a good man who did a terrible thing for love, with the whole House watching him decide. The sliver stays in the wall under forty beds, one with the rock; the lid is off and whoever set it will know. Maelis has walked away from his telling and keeps two pieces of black glass in her coat. His fingertips are numb under the linen. The knee holds a stair at the Mender's count and no more, and the soft season is not over.
last_beat: Nobody answered him. The snow came in at the wicket and lay on the flags, and the almoner stood with his sister's hair inside his shirt and the stores key in his fist, and waited to be told.

maelis.note: has told him what she dared, and not where she learned it; the Confessor's eyes found her at the gate; she approved his name at the bars in her own coin

hollis.note: second on the list, read at the bars; dry, and has told Darrow so; saw him move at his name, and called him Captain when he gave it

wren.note: afraid; hides it with numbers; ran for the bell on his word; made him promise to tell her first next time

rae.note: the carter of the last cart; came up the Steps with his letter in her shirt and calls him Darrow, not Ser, not Captain; her stake sits beside his on NOBODY in the kitchen's book, and he owes her an aye; goes down to her oxen at the winch-house and comes up when she is owing

choices.text: Tell the lay brothers the Faithless went down the far side a week ago. Let the valley carry it.
Step forward and answer to his name.
Ask Maelis to take him down herself, on her terms: her count, a hand on Wren's shoulder, her right to say stop.
Write back as a brother: he will not kneel, and why
Send down his name as surety: a captain's word, though the Faithless have no credit in the Lowmarch.
Tell Hollis and the far cots' keepers first, and the Prior only after: his own people before the House's law.

inventory: a borrowed stick he refuses to use

recaps._about: One-line 'previously' per chapter file slug, shown at the top of that chapter in the reader. Spoiler-free; only what earlier chapters showed.
recaps.01-the-confessor-at-the-steps: At Harrow Ford the Grace went out of the Ninth Lance in mid-river, and only a thread of it came back; Darrow's knee gave way with no blade near it, and forty-one of his sixty did not come home. Carried up the Thousand Steps to Saint Ysolde's, he chose Maelis Vorne's Binding over kneeling again at the Oathspire.
recaps.02-the-grey-cot: The House was frightened, the Confessor had given it a word, and a lad lay Hollowed in the Grey Cot with frost on his mouth; Darrow, with Wren for his legs, went looking for whoever had passed in the night, and found that nobody had.
recaps.03-the-undercroft: Under the House, in a hall older than it, Darrow found what makes the stone grow frost: a black sliver shut in the wall beneath the row with a lid of new mortar, carried up the Steps in the House's own letter-satchel. It would not come out of the rock; the cold whitened his fingers before he let it go on the Mender's word, and it stays. Now the whole House has seen them come up, and he must decide who is told.
